description: A versioned SQL file that Flyway applies once and records in its history table, so every environment evolves the schema the same way.
The Hibernate setting validate, which checks at startup that entities match the existing tables instead of changing them.
A declaration of which relationships to load in the same query, used to avoid one extra select per row.
Marking a row as deleted with a timestamp and filtering it from queries, so the data stays in the table.
A unique index with a WHERE clause, such as one that applies only to rows that are not deleted.
An integration test that starts the real database in a Testcontainers container instead of an embedded substitute.
